meta.name: p-image
meta.description: Generate images with Pruna P-Image models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Image, P-Image-LoRA, P-Image-Edit, P-Image-Edit-LoRA. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, LoRA styles, multi-image compositing, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna, p-image, pruna image, fast image generation, optimized flux, pruna ai, p image, fast ai image, economic image generation, cheap image generation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Pruna 优化模型快速生成和编辑图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或编辑图片且不想牺牲质量
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images quickly with Pruna optimized models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast image generation or editing without quality loss

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行调用 Pruna 的 P-Image 系列模型生成或编辑图片，支持文生图、图片编辑、LoRA 风格、多图合成等。
howto.when: 当你说出“pruna”、“p-image”、“快速生成图片”等关键词，或要求生成/编辑图片时触发。

say.text: 用 pruna 生成一张日落时的未来城市风景图。
把这张图片的背景换成海滩。
say.note: 触发图片编辑，需提供图片链接。

say.text: 用 pruna 的 LoRA 风格生成一张像素艺术风格的猫。
say.note: 触发带 LoRA 预设的文生图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Pruna P-Image models via CLI to generate or edit images, supporting text-to-image, image editing, LoRA styles, and multi-image compositing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "pruna", "p-image", "fast image generation", or ask to generate/edit an image.

say_en.text: Generate a futuristic cityscape at sunset using pruna.
Change the background of this image to a beach.
say_en.note: Triggers image editing; requires image URL.

say_en.text: Generate a pixel art style cat using pruna LoRA.
